messages:
Celeste (PM): quick thread for v1.11.1 release notes + internal announce. Change window tonight 02:00 UTC. Primary: routing buffer fix and pin shuffle. Need: one-line customer blurb, internal RN copy, pin owner, and rollback gates. cc @here :sparkles:

Ibrahim (Eng): canary plan: 6% in us-east-1 for 20m. monitors: redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, system.net.queue_depth. auto-rollback if errors > 1.2% for 5m OR queue_depth > 200 for 10m.

Renee (Ops): ops will take pin ownership during rollout. rationale: touches routing layer and ops can flip pins quickly. We'll run final smoke at T-10m.

Maya (Docs): suggested public blurb: "v1.11.1: routing buffer fix & stability improvements. No API changes." Internal RN will include canary plan, rollback criteria, and links to runbook. Drafting now.

Ibrahim (Eng): deploy command ready. will kick at 02:05 UTC after smoke.

```
/deploy release/v1.11.1 --canary=6% --duration=20m --region=us-east-1 --notes="pin:ops"
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy b4c5d6. scheduled start 02:05 UTC. monitors: redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, system.net.queue_depth.

Pat (Oncall): Pat and Jordan on watch. runbook: http://go/runbooks/routing-buffer-rollback. will escalate to Renee if gates hit.

deploy-bot: canary started at 02:05 UTC. reporting window open.

Pat (Oncall): initial numbers look ok. p95 stable, errors 0.2%, queue_depth ~75.

Ibrahim (Eng): adding extra logs for queue probes and enabling verbose telemetry for 10m.

deploy-bot: at 02:18 UTC, observed transient queue_depth spike to 210 on one AZ for 3m; no error increase.

Renee (Ops): seeing the spike; it's isolated to az-1a. Ops will drain that AZ and monitor. not triggering rollback threshold (needs 10m sustained).

Pat (Oncall): after AZ drain queue_depth back to baseline ~80. continuing to observe.

deploy-bot: canary complete at 02:25 UTC  preliminary metrics: p95 +2% vs baseline, errors 0.3%, queue_depth stable. ready to promote unless vetoed.

Celeste (PM): no veto from product. proceed to promote.

deploy-bot: promoted to 100% at 02:31 UTC. release tag: v1.11.1. summary: p95 +2%, errors 0.3%, queue_depth nominal. :tada:

Maya (Docs): posting RN draft here for signoff: "v1.11.1  routing buffer fix and pin consolidation. No API changes. Ops-owned rollout; isolated queue spike on canary handled by AZ drain. No customer-impacting issues observed." Thoughts?

Renee (Ops): RN looks good. pin owner confirmed (Ops). rationale: need quick rollback control for routing changes.

Celeste (PM): approve. Maya please post internal announce to #eng-all and schedule the customer blurb for 9:00 PT tomorrow. Tag ops and oncall.

Maya (Docs): posted internal announce at 03:05 UTC with the calm blurb. customer blurb scheduled. closing thread once customer blurb goes live.

deploy-bot: log: deploy b4c5d6 promoted to v1.11.1 at 02:31 UTC. artifacts: ci/b4c5d6/build.log, ops/telemetry/b4c5d6/summary.json.

Pat (Oncall): oncall done; no lingering alerts. Marking this as resolved unless anyone objects.

Celeste (PM): thanks team  pin owner set, RN posted, rollback criteria documented. closing thread.
